fields.unit: molar refractivity; frozen schema does not declare a unit

r73.code_mapping_source: Resolve each dataset schema.r73_channel_codebook by label; the pilot integer code map is descriptive, not universal across new codebooks.
r73.directions_onsite_duplicates: original pair direction, onsite rows and duplicate entries are retained in their sums
r73.missingness: any invalid selected term masks that pair/channel; no selected entries gives NaN; never zero fill
r73.mixed_or_delta: outside requested sigma/pi blocks; original raw r73 records remain unchanged
r73.pi: sum entries where basis_i and basis_j both end with -PI, by the original pair_index row
r73.sigma: sum entries where basis_i and basis_j both end with -SIGMA, by the original pair_index row
r73.target_storage: Prefer schema.derived_r73_pair_targets sigma/pi: arrays[27] at declared column_index. D6 sums original F64 pure blocks, then casts once to F32. Historical D3 without derived schema may aggregate raw F32 K; its rounding is retained and no re-export is required.

r73_user_decision: 2026-11-05用户明确批准同对称性分块：sigma-sigma sum，pi-pi sum；mixed/delta不纳入两列，原始r73完整保留。
typical_scale_definition: RMS of valid pilot TRAIN values, in the original field unit
vector_fields: pool component observations only when the registry field_key itself is one vector; distinct component field_keys stay distinct
